name: 🥗 Buffalo Chicken & White Bean Salad
what: Buffalo chicken and white beans with ranch and crunchy veggies over lettuce.
early: Optional: the chicken-bean mix keeps 3 days and is better on day 2.

core.name: Frank's RedHot
core.out: any hot sauce, or BBQ sauce for no heat

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Stir 3 Tbsp Frank's into 1 Tbsp melted butter. Toss with the chopped chicken.
Add the drained beans and any crunchy veggies.
Fold in the ranch. Serve over lettuce.
For lunches: mix and lettuce in separate containers.

key: Butter in the hot sauce takes the edge off the heat.
done: Everything's coated and it tastes good with a spoon.
plan_b: No chicken? Make it with beans, or tuck it in a wrap.
